[a] The CPX-POM exposure expressed in days is calculated from the dose administration entered in the database as (last dose
taken date - first dose taken date + 1) + 16.
[b] The CPX-POM exposure expressed in mg is calculated from the dose per m^2 entered in the database as the sum of all (dose
per m^2 x Body Surface Area), using Body Surface Area calculated at baseline for Cycle 1 and Cycle 2 dose administrations,
and calculated on Day 1 of every other treatment cycle from Cycle 3 dose administration.
